title: Energy-preserving Bayesian model reduction: closed-form structured posteriors and probabilistic stability certificates for quadratic operator inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.27794v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian operator inference learns reduced-order models (ROMs) with polynomial structure from state data and returns a closed-form Gaussian posterior over the reduced operators. That posterior is unconstrained, so it gives positive probability to operators with unbounded dynamics, and current practice controls this only through finite-horizon simulation tests on a few samples. We show that energy preservation of the quadratic operator is a set of linear equality constraints, which can be imposed exactly inside the Bayesian formulation without losing the closed form. In particular, the constrained posterior follows from one Kalman-type update of the unconstrained one, and its samples are obtained exactly, by the same correction applied to unconstrained draws. translated_title: 能量保持的贝叶斯模型降阶：面向二次算子推断的闭式结构化后验与概率稳定性证书
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯算子推断从状态数据中学习具有多项式结构的降阶模型（ROM），并返回关于降阶算子的闭式高斯后验。该后验是无约束的，因此会给动力学无界的算子赋予正概率，而现有做法仅通过对少量样本进行有限时域的仿真测试来控制这一问题。我们证明，二次算子的能量保持性可以表示为一组线性等式约束，可以在贝叶斯框架内精确施加而不失去闭式形式。特别地，约束后验只需对无约束后验进行一次卡尔曼类型的更新即可得到，其样本也可通过对无约束抽样施加相同的修正而精确获得。在这种结构下，针对所有初始条件和有界输入的全局有界性问题可归结为线性算子对称部分上的一个线性矩阵条件。仿真……
tldr: 该论文提出在贝叶斯二次算子推断中通过线性等式约束精确施加能量保持性，在不失去闭式高斯后验形式的同时获得全局有界性的线性矩阵稳定条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that energy preservation in Bayesian quadratic operator inference can be imposed exactly via linear equality constraints, preserving closed-form Gaussian posteriors and yielding a linear matrix condition for global boundedness.
